eligibility: exact synthetic prompt hashes, budgets, sampling and cold-cache state match
all feature, capacity and output-parity gates pass
compare end-to-end and steady decode separately; retain graph-capture cost
minimum two complete repetitions; investigate greater-than-10-percent spread before a marginal decision
improvement: At least 5 percent median end-to-end or eligible steady-decode improvement in C1 code/prose or C32, or a documented substantial memory reduction without throughput loss.
regression_guard: No unexplained median regression above 10 percent in C1 code/prose, C32, or matched deep-context decode/prefill; inspect latency and long-context failures separately.
judgment: Automated ratios are evidence, not authorization to waive feature, stability, context or restoration gates. A marginal/noisy result requires more matched measurements, not rounding to passed.
additional_feature_gate: Small text/schema/image requests must finish during long native prefill within a declared 30-second bound; exact output parity, partial-prefill cancellation and relocation must pass.
